lines: Willie: Hey, you look like a trainer passing through! Let's have a quick battle at the stand.

intro: Willie: Hey, you look like a trainer passing through! Let's have a quick battle at the stand.
player_won: Willie: Whoa! You're the real thing!

lines: You rev the motorbike and race across the dunes.
Sand sprays behind you. Orre has no tall grass, only desert, rock and wind.
Men in strange uniforms are scaring people at the fountain!
Cipher Peon: Orre belongs to Cipher! Our Shadow Pokemon can't be stopped!

player_won: Peon: Retreat! Tell the admins a trainer with real Pokemon is here!

done: The fountain sparkles again. Phenac is safe, for now.

lines: Rui: You beat them! Did you see that dark aura? Those were Shadow Pokemon.
Cipher closes Pokemon's hearts so they only want to fight. It's so cruel!
Team Snagem left this machine behind when Cipher took over: a Snag Machine.
With it you can catch a Shadow Pokemon from a Cipher trainer and save it!
Take Shadow Pokemon to the Relic Stone in Agate Village to open their hearts.
Snattle: As the former mayor, I welcome you... to your defeat!

intro: Snattle: As the former mayor, I welcome you... to your defeat!
player_won: Snattle: How dare you!

intro: Welcome to the final round of the Phenac Stadium! The winner takes the Phenac Badge!
player_won: You won the Phenac Stadium! Here's the Phenac Badge!
player_lost: So close! Train up and enter the next tournament.

requirements.fail_text: The tournament isn't open to you yet. Keep following Cipher's trail!

ORRE_POKE_SPOTS.description: Three Poké Spots in the desert (Rock, Oasis and Cave), where wild Pokémon come for Poké Snacks. A Munchlax turns up now and then.

lines: Pofty: ...and here's the man who found them! Duking, how did you discover the Poke Spots?
Duking: Fifteen years of looking, and hardly a wink of sleep! Put out a Poke Snack, and wild Pokemon come.
Duking: Oh - it's you, kid! There's another one, an oasis near Pyrite. I'll meet you there.

done: Duking: Poke Spots! Who'd have thought, right here in Orre?

lines: Pofty: Pofty, ONBS news! This scoop is going to make my career!
A familiar tune... Miror B. is here, dancing with Shadow Pokemon!
Sheriff: Pyrite's a rough town, kid. Outlaws on every corner.
Lately Cipher's been running things from The Under, the old city below us.
Clear them out and Agate Village will want to meet you.

intro: The final round of the Pyrite Colosseum! The winner takes the Pyrite Badge!
player_won: You won the Pyrite Colosseum! Here's the Pyrite Badge, and TM175 (TOXIC)!
player_lost: So close! Come back and enter again.

requirements.fail_text: The Colosseum is dark. The windmill isn't turning, so there's no power!

lines: Silva is gone, but something heavy is wedged against the fence...
You found the GEAR!
Rui: This must be the windmill's missing gear! Let's take it back to Pyrite.
Silva is on the floor, beaten. Two Miror B. Peons stand over him.
Miror B. Peon Reath: Another hero? Miror B. warned us about you!

player_won: Miror B. Peon Reath: Ferma, your turn!

lines: Miror B. Peon Ferma: You won't get past me so easily!

player_won: Miror B. Peon Ferma: No! Miror B.!
Silva: You... you know Duking? Then tell him I'm sorry. I only wanted to save Plusle.
Miror B. appears on the TV screen: Oh-ho-ho! Looking for little Plusle? She was the bait, and you took it!
Miror B.: Come and find me, if your feet can keep up! Ciao!

fail: Miror B. Peon Ferma: Reath goes first. Then it is my turn!

lines: Hunter Doken: Miror B. got away? Doesn't matter. Nobody gets to Pyrite Cave past me!

player_won: Hunter Doken: Fine! Go on to the cave. You'll regret it.

fail: Hunter Doken: Nobody gets to Pyrite Cave. Miror B.'s orders.

lines: Something is tucked under the healing machine... You found EIN FILE H!
You found 5 GREAT BALLS!
You found a REVIVE!
A file lies forgotten on the roof... You found EIN FILE S!
You found 3 HYPER POTIONS!
Chaser Kai: This lift goes down to the Under. Cipher's orders: nobody gets on.
Chaser Kai: You want past? Beat me first!
Duking: Made it! See the water? Pokemon love it here.
Duking: If you catch a Trapinch, a Surskit or a Wooper, I'll trade you something rare for each.
Duking: The last spot's a cave, up past Agate Village. Go have a look!
Duking: Got a Trapinch, a Surskit or a Wooper for me?
fail: Duking: Nothing yet? Trapinch, Surskit or Wooper - one of each, and something rare for each.

lines: A familiar tune... Miror B. is here, dancing with Shadow Pokemon!
Music fills the room. A man with a huge afro is dancing, four Ludicolo dancing beside him.
Miror B.: Stop the music! ...Well, well. The famous snag-happy kid, here in my little hideaway.
Miror B.: You want Plusle back? Then dance with me! Ludicolo, let's groove!

player_won: Miror B.: My rhythm... it's been broken! Ludicolo, we're leaving!
Miror B. and his Ludicolo dance away. Behind where they stood, Plusle sits shivering.
Silva and Duking burst in. Duking: Plusle! You found her!
Duking scoops Plusle up and heads home to Pyrite.

lines: Mirakle B.: I'm Mirakle B.! Miror B.'s one true successor! And one day I'll have an afro just like his!

player_won: Mirakle B.: No! My dream afro... you've crushed it!
Mirakle B.: I don't care what anyone says. I'm still Miror B.'s heir!

lines: Miror B. Peon Reath: Miror B.'s gone, so this cave is ours now. And we've been training!

player_won: Miror B. Peon Reath: Still not enough...

lines: Miror B. Peon Ferma: You again? This time we're ready for you!

player_won: Miror B. Peon Ferma: Ugh! Miror B. would be so disappointed.

lines: Miror B. left a box behind... You found TM299 (SNATCH)!
fail: A box, locked tight. Miror B.'s dancers are guarding it.

player_won: Cipher Peon Skrub: You'll regret this! Cipher always gets its way!
Skrub runs, dropping a file on the way. Eagun gets back on his feet.
Eagun: You've got real strength. Come home with us. There's something you should know about the Relic Stone.

lines: You found a SILK SCARF!
You found 2 ULTRA BALLS!

fail: The Relic Stone glows softly. The forest feels like it's waiting for something.
lines: Every Shadow Pokemon you saved gathers around the Relic Stone.
A shooting star falls into the forest... and a tiny Pokemon with a star on its head wakes up!
It's Jirachi, the Wish Pokemon. It looks at you, curious.

boss.name: Ho-Oh

Ho-Oh descends, drawn by the hearts you opened!
Miror B.: Ooh, a cave with groove! And who's this? I've got a feeling you're trouble!
Miror B.: Let's dance!

player_won: Miror B.: My groove! Folly, Trudly, we're leaving!
Miror B. dances off... and drops something: the Miror B. Radar!

lines: The studio lights blaze. Venus is about to go on air.
Venus: Hm? Who let you in? ...Wait. You're the spies!

intro: Venus: Spies, in MY studio? On my big day?!
Venus: Very well. Let all of Orre watch me win!
player_won: Venus: No, no, NO! This is not how my show ends!
Venus spins round and runs from the studio, down the back stairs.

lines: Three Rare Candies, tucked under the newsreader's desk.
Venus dropped a file as she ran: Ein File F.

Boy: Here - the Power Up Part. Take it to Nett. His house has the dish on the roof.

Nascour: Ein, your Shadow Pokemon research must go on. Venus, keep the Under in line.
Ein: Of course. My files will see to it. ...The screen goes dark.
done: Boy: Nett's house is the one with the dish on the roof. Go on!

lines: Nett: Who are you? Kids Grid business only. Unless you've got the Power Up Part...

Nett: With this, our network's back up. Megg, take their P*DA number!
Megg: Got it! We'll send you anything we hear.
A shout from outside: "We caught the spy!" ...They've locked up Silva!
Nett: Ein's Data ROM? Let me crack it... It's a list of every Shadow Pokemon Cipher made!
Nett: Someone erased most of it. But it points to one place: Realgam Tower.

done: Nett: The Kids Grid is watching Venus. We'll tell you anything we find.

Megg: I keep the Kids Grid's address book. You're in it now!

player_won: Kloak: Ugh... Dagur, get them!

lines: Cipher Peon Dagur: You beat Kloak? Then you're mine!
Silva: (through the bars) Watch those two peons. Deal with them and come back.

Silva: I snatched this off a peon before they grabbed me: the R-Disk. The floating platform takes it.
Silva: F sends it forward, R sends it right. Right is Venus's studio. Go!

done: Silva: I'll get out of here somehow. Go stop Venus!

lines: You slot the U-Disk in. The platform rises... up and up, through a hatch...
It stops inside Pyrite's windmill! On a ledge lies a flute that hums with time: another Time Flute!
The platform sinks back down to the Under.

done: The floating platform. Its slot takes disks: F sends it forward, R right, U up.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Welcome to Orre
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You rode into the Outskirt Stand at dawn. A rider is sitting at the far end of the diner. Talk to him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trouble in Phenac
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Willie said to sharpen your skills in Phenac City. Ride there. Those men with the sack were headed the same way...

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Mayor of Phenac
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Rui saw Pokémon with a dark aura. Take her to Mayor Es Cade. His house is on the west side of town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Poké Balls
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Your Snag Machine can catch Shadow Pokémon, but you have no Poké Balls. Ask the bartender at the Outskirt Stand.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trouble at the Mayor's
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Something's wrong at the Mayor's house in Phenac City! Hurry back.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Phenac's Guards
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Three men in strange outfits are guarding Phenac's ways out, each with a Shadow Pokémon. Beat one and snag its Pokémon!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pyrite Town
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Pyrite is a rough town. Shadow Pokémon are being handed out in its duel square! Then find Rogue Cail: a thug by the Colosseum knows where he is.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Missing Gear
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Silva took the Gear from Duking's windmill, and the Colosseum has no power. He may have hidden it at the Construction Lot. Ride there from Pyrite's bike.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pyrite Colosseum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The windmill turns again and the Colosseum has power. Win its four rounds for the Pyrite Badge!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cipher's Hideout
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Miror B.'s gang took Duking's Plusle! Their hideout is the Pyrite Building, by the bridge. Get to the roof, then past the guard to Pyrite Cave.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Miror B. in Pyrite Cave
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher Admin Miror B. is hiding in Pyrite Cave with Shadow Pokémon. Dance your way past him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Agate Village
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Fateen saw trouble coming to Agate Village, where Rui's grandparents live. Ride north and visit the elder's house.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Relic Cave
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher's men pushed into the Relic Cave, and Rui's grandfather Eagun went after them. Follow him in!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Dakim at Mt. Battle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher Admin Dakim is attacking Mt. Battle, next to Agate Village. Stop him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Vander's Thanks
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Dakim fled Mt. Battle. Talk to Area Leader Vander, the trainer Dakim beat, at the top of Area 1.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Elevator Key
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Duking caught two of Miror B.'s peons; they're in the cells at Pyrite's sheriff's office. Take the Jail Key from the desk and see what they're carrying.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Into The Under
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Elevator Key works the Pyrite Building's giant lift down to The Under, a town Venus runs from her TV studio. Find the kids fighting her: the Kids Grid.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Silva in a Cage
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Under's Cipher peons locked Silva up as a spy. Deal with his two guards and talk to him.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Venus's Studio
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With the F-Disk and the R-Disk, the floating platform reaches Venus's TV studio. Beat Cipher Admin Venus!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: After Venus
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Venus ran down the studio's back stairs to the old subway. Follow her, and find the key to the Shadow Pokemon Lab's main gate.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Under Colosseum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Under has its own Colosseum. Win its tournament for the second badge!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ein's Shadow Pokémon Lab
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher makes Shadow Pokémon in a secret lab. Find Cipher Admin Ein and stop the machines!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trouble at the HQ Lab
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Krane's Pokemon HQ Lab, near Gateon Port, works on purifying Shadow Pokemon. Pay it a visit.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Machine Part
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher took Professor Krane. Lily needs a Machine Part for the Purify Chamber: ask Perr at Gateon Port's Parts Shop. His dad Makan is at Kaminko's House.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lovrina's Cipher Lab
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Datan traced Cipher's car to the old Shadow Pokemon Lab, reopened as the Cipher Lab. Rescue Professor Krane and beat Cipher Admin Lovrina!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Data for Nett
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Krane is home. Take his research data to Nett at the ONBS building in Pyrite Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Duking's Poke Spots
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Duking has found Poke Spots, where wild Pokemon appear. Meet him at the Rock Poke Spot off the Desert Trail, then the Oasis and the Cave.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The ONBS Building
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher took over Orre's TV station in Pyrite Town! Battle Commander Exol and get it back.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The S.S. Libra
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher took the S.S. Libra, and a little girl's Bonsly was aboard. The ship lies in the deep sand: Gateon's Parts Shop may know how to cross it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Snattle at Phenac Stadium
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Phenac's old mayor, Snattle, is really a Cipher Admin! He's waiting at Phenac Stadium.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Phenac Stadium
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Now win Phenac Stadium's tournament for the third badge!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Snagem Hideout
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Snagem's hideout is out in the desert. Their boss, Gonzap, has Shadow Pokémon too. Take him on!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Orre Colosseum
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The biggest tournament in Orre! Win it for the last badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cipher Key Lair
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher's last base is under Gateon Port. Beat Cipher Admin Gorigan to learn where their leader is.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Realgam Tower
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher's leader is Evice, the man who built Realgam Tower. Beat his admins and then Evice himself to save Orre!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Professor Krane's Eevee
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Krane works at the Pokémon HQ Lab in Gateon Port. Pay him a visit!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ein's Data ROM
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Ein left a Data ROM on his desk. Take it to Nett at the Kids Grid in The Under.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mt. Battle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: After the title, Vander waits at the very top of Mt. Battle, past Battlus in Area 10. Climb up and face him!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mt. Battle's 100
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Mt. Battle, near Agate Village: ten areas, ten trainers in each. Climb them all and beat Mt. Battle Master Battlus! Rest at the top of each area to start from the next one.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Wishing Star
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher's files mention a wishing star near Agate's Relic Stone. Look in the Relic Forest.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ho-Oh's Blessing
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Purify every Shadow Pokémon at the Relic Stone. Then a rainbow Pokémon may appear in the Relic Forest.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Gale of Darkness
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cipher is back under Grand Master Greevil! Sail from Gateon Port to Citadark Isle and beat his three admins, then Greevil.

orre_newgame_intro: Far from the green regions lies Orre, a dry land of sand, rock and wind.
Hardly any wild Pokémon live in its grass. Trainers here battle in big stadiums called Colosseums.
But lately, something is wrong. Some Pokémon have had their hearts shut tight. They attack anyone, even people.
People call them Shadow Pokémon. A secret group called Cipher is making them.
Your motorbike rumbles to a stop at Outskirt Stand, an old train turned into a diner at the edge of the desert.
orre_partners_intro: Two Pokémon hop down from the sidecar: Espeon and Umbreon.
They grew up together as Eevee, and they have never been apart.
Which one will lead the way beside you?
orre_partners_join: {other} doesn't want to be left behind! It bounds after {lead} and joins your team too.
With {lead} and {other} at your side, your journey through Orre begins!
